CHAPTER.VERS: Not many teachers become you, brethren of me, knowing, that greater condemnation we shall receive.
Many for we stumble all; if any one in word not stumbles, this a perfect man, able to bridle and whole the body.
Lo, of the horses the bits into the mouths we put in order that to make obedient them to us, and whole the body of them we turn about.
Lo, also the ships, so great being, and by violent winds being driven, are turned about by a very small helm, wherever the will of the one steering pleases.
Thus also the tongue a little member is, and greatly boasts. Lo, a little fire how great a mass of fuel kindles.

And the tongue of fire, the world of the wickedness; thus the tongue is placed among the members of us, that spotting whole the body, and setting on fire the wheel of the nature, and being set on fire by the gehenna.
Every for species of wild beasts both and of birds, of reptiles both and of things in the sea, is subdued and has been subdued by the nature by that belonging to man;
the but tongue no one is able of men to subdue; and unruly evil, full of poison deathproducing.
By her we bless the God and Father, and by her we curse the men those according to a likeness of God having been made;
out of the same mouth goes forth blessing and cursing. Not ought, brethren of me, these things so to be.
Not the fountain out of the same opening send forth the sweet and the bitter?
Not is able, brethren of me, a fig tree olives to produce, or a vine figs? thus neither salt sweet to make water.
Any one wise and discreet among you? let him show out of the honorable conduct the works of himself with meekness of wisdom;
if but rivalry bitter you have and strife in the heart of you, not do you boast and do you speak falsely concerning the truth?
Not is this the wisdom from above coming down, but earthly, soulical, demoniacal.
Where for rivalry and strife, there disorder and every foul deed.
The but from above wisdom first indeed pure it is, then peaceable, gentle, easily persuaded, full of mercy and of fruits good, without partiality and without hypocrisy.
Fruit and of righteousness in peace is sown by those making peace.
